text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm going to wedge the merge queue for tonight's release cut at 21:00 UTC. Need a short rollback plan and on-call watch for a terraform apply that touches shared-egress and a couple IAM roles. :warning:

sam: Ack. Scope: any tfstate moves or big provider upgrades?

maria: No tfstate migration. Plan touches route tables + one nat-gw replace + two iam role policy updates. Provider pinned in the plan to 1.4.2.

deploybot: DRY RUN finished (maria): `terraform plan -out=preapply.tfplan` -> no drifts reported, 1 replace on module.natgw, 3 updates. Full output: https://ci/reports/1719991234/dryrun

alex: Suggest canary first — apply to eu-west-1a only using var az=eu-west-1a or `-target=module.shared_egress["eu-west-1a"]` and monitor. If stable, sweep. If we see any route flaps or 5xx, rollback.

jin: Manual lock please: `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan && terraform apply plan.tfplan` and keep merge queue held until `apply:ok` posted. Also set `-parallelism=2` for the nat-gw step.

ops-oncall: Watchlist/alerts I’ll have up: egress-5xx-rate (threshold 0.5%), route-change-loss (threshold 0.1%), p99 latency across api-gateway. If any trigger -> kill-switch and manual rollback. I’m on standby at the channel.

maria: Run order decided: 1) apply shared_egress module (targeted) 2) verify routing smoke 3) apply iam updates. Keep provider pinned to 1.4.2, do not auto-upgrade.

alex: +1 on provider pin. Release notes blurb drafted: "Network egress routing tweak; no user-visible API changes." Add rollback steps in the ticket (how to reattach ENI and restore previous route table snapshot).

sam: Fallback if nat-gw replace fails: reattach previous GW ENI and programmatically point route table back to snapshot using `aws ec2 replace-route` command from runbook. I'll paste snippet in the ticket.

deploybot: APPLY STARTED by maria at 21:01 UTC. Command: ```terraform apply -target=module.shared_egress -parallelism=2 plan.tfplan``` Streaming logs: https://ci/reports/1719991234/apply

ops-oncall: Observing p99 latency spike at 21:03 and small route flaps. Raising kill-switch now.

alex: Initiating rollback procedure — reattach original ENI and restore route table entries (performed). Rolling back IAM step if not yet applied.

deploybot: Rollback run by alex completed at 21:04 UTC. Steps executed: restore-route-table -> detach new nat -> reattach old ENI -> verify route propagation. No IAM changes applied. Logs: https://ci/reports/1719991234/rollback

maria: Thanks — good fast work. Outcome: brief customer-facing blip ~1.5min, rollback successful. Postmortem notes: nat-gw hot-swap caused transient route reconvergence. Action items: add preflight that asserts route stability, include nat-gw replacement in canary next time, add small smoke test post-apply for egress path.

jin: I'll add the preflight + smoke test and update the terraform pipeline to enforce targeted canary for nat-gw replaces.

alex: Also adding a short runbook snippet to the release ticket with the `aws ec2` rollback commands.

maria: Closing the wedge and releasing merge queue in 10m, unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
